name: c-wrapper-nodejs-addon
description: This is start app setup to start writing c/c++ wrapper as node js add-on to use in nodejs. Aim of this project is to include all dependencies needed to use to write wrapper so that a user can just install it using traditional `npm start` command. And then it is ready with sample c++ add-on that can be called in node module.
author: Muhammad Shahzad Anjum <muhammad.shahzada.anjum@gmail.com>
